commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Girona fail to score from a corner as Adrian (Betis) leaps to collect the ball.
90+5' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Miguel Gutierrez (Girona), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
90+5' A cross from a corner kick by Girona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

90+4' Donny van de Beek (Girona) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.
90+3' David Lopez (Girona) tries to convince the referee to change his mind and receives a yellow card for dissent.
90+2' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the free kick and attempts to find some of his teammates inside the box, but the ball is intercepted and cleared out of danger.
90+1' A yellow card for a tackle by Romain Perraud (Betis). Alejandro Hernandez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' The substitution has been made. Sergi Altimira (Betis) has replaced Abde Ezzalzouli.
89' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
85' 1 - 3 Goal! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:3.
85' The linesman makes the right call and Girona will have a corner.
83' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Adrian easily deals with the threat.
83' Portu (Girona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
81' Portu (Girona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Adrian intercepts the ball.
79' Donny van de Beek (Girona) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
78' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Antony will be replaced by Jesus Rodriguez (Betis).
78' A substitution has been made. Pablo Fornals goes off and William Carvalho (Betis) comes on.
75' Antony (Betis) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
73' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
72' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes it short.
72' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
72' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the corner with a short pass.
71' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Betis will take a corner kick.
70' One of the players from Girona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
70' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Adrian sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.
68' Michel has decided to substitute Arnaut Danjuma and he is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. David Lopez (Girona) for Alejandro Frances.
66' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
65' The foul by Alejandro Frances (Girona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Alejandro Hernandez.
64' Girona are ruled offside.

63' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post.
63' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is about to take a corner kick.
62' What a sweet touch by Antony (Betis) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Paulo Gazzaniga to hold.
60' A substitution has been made. Isco is replaced by Giovani Lo Celso (Betis).
59' Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
57' Michel has decided to make a change. Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) replaces Yangel Herrera.
57' Substitution. Yaser Asprilla walks off the pitch and Donny van de Beek (Girona) comes on as a substitute.
57' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' Portu (Girona) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
53' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
53' A lofted cross from Antony (Betis) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
52' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Arthur Melo (Girona) for a tough tackle.
51' Portu (Girona) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
50' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Adrian comes off the line to clear the ball away.
50' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar.
50' Isco (Betis) takes the corner.

49' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Paulo Gazzaniga makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended inside the right post. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
49' Betis have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
48' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Flag goes up against Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' Manuel Pellegrini makes a switch. Hector Bellerin is coming on in place of Aitor Ruibal (Betis) at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Ivan Martin (Girona) will not participate anymore and Portu is coming on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Alejandro Hernandez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

45+3' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out of play. Girona are awarded a corner kick.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' Antony (Betis) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

44' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome. The ball is out of play and Betis manage to earn a corner.

42' 0 - 3 Goal! Abde Ezzalzouli clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Isco (Betis), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the left side of the goal. Paulo Gazzaniga had no chance of stopping that. 0:3.
42' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) gets inside the box and tries to beat Paulo Gazzaniga with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.

39' 0 - 2 Antony (Betis) meets a perfect cross from Romain Perraud deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:2.
38' The linesman raises his flag. Yangel Herrera (Girona) is adjudged offside.
37' Marc Bartra (Betis) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
36' Isco (Betis) will deliver the corner kick.
36' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Betis force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
36' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
34' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
33' A crossfield pass from Ladislav Krejci (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates.
33' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
30' A player from Girona commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
30' The ball is out of play. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner.
29' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Adrian thwarts him with a great two-handed save.

27' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
26' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) picks up a yellow card.
25' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
22' Yangel Herrera (Girona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
20' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
19' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
18' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
18' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) is flagged for offside.
16' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
14' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
13' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
13' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Girona are awarded a corner kick.
13' Girona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
11' Antony (Betis) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
8' Half-chance! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) plays a pass into the box, but Adrian reacts well to snuff out the attack.

6' 0 - 1 Goal! Isco launched the corner kick and superbly found the head of Johnny Cardoso (Betis), whose accurate effort from near the penalty spot went straight into the bottom right corner. It's 0:1.
6' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Betis.
6' Antony (Betis) attempts to curl the ball over the wall from the free kick, but one of the defenders deflects it away from danger.
4' The game is interrupted now, Aitor Ruibal (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
4' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle and signals a foul after Yangel Herrera (Girona) brought his opponent down. A free kick to Betis.
3' Antony (Betis) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

3' Isco (Betis) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Arthur Melo (Girona).
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Betis will kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
